+  const edgeNames = contract.edge_families.map((edge) => edge.edge_family);
+  const postureFields = contract.posture_axes.map((axis) => axis.field);
+  const invariantIds = contract.count_conservation_invariants.map((invariant) => invariant.invariant_id);
+
+  const checks = [
+    {
+      id: 'required_node_families_defined',
+      status: REQUIRED_NODE_FAMILIES.every((node) => nodeNames.includes(node)) ? 'pass' : 'fail',
+    },
+    {
+      id: 'required_edge_families_defined',
+      status: REQUIRED_EDGE_FAMILIES.every((edge) => edgeNames.includes(edge)) ? 'pass' : 'fail',
+    },
+    {
+      id: 'required_posture_axes_defined',
+      status: [
+        'question_availability',
+        'student_display_eligible_final',
+        'visual_evidence_posture',
+        'receipt_replay_status',
+        'method_diagnostic_posture',
+        'rights_display_status',
+        'review_routing_posture',
+      ].every((field) => postureFields.includes(field)) ? 'pass' : 'fail',
+    },
+    {
+      id: 'scope_counts_preserve_3530_and_858',
+      status: contract.scope.real_9709_question_rows === 3530
+        && contract.scope.normalized_plain_text_rows === 3530
+        && contract.scope.text_only_ready_rows === 2672
+        && contract.scope.visual_required_rows === 858
+        ? 'pass'
+        : 'fail',
+    },
+    {
+      id: 'count_conservation_invariants_present',
+      status: [
+        'question_nodes_conserve_full_beta_runtime_scope',
+        'text_visual_partition_conserves_question_rows',
+        'visual_required_rows_conserve_figureasset_partition',
+        'student_display_eligible_visual_rows_fail_closed_zero_currently',
+      ].every((id) => invariantIds.includes(id)) ? 'pass' : 'fail',
+    },
+    {
+      id: 'visual_receipt_terminal_partition_conserves_858',
+      status: contract.scope.source_visual_receipt_accepted_rows + contract.scope.visual_terminal_blocker_rows === contract.scope.visual_required_rows
+        ? 'pass'
+        : 'fail',
+    },
+    {
+      id: 'blocked_evidence_statuses_are_categorical_exclusions',
+      status: contract.posture_axes.find((axis) => axis.field === 'method_diagnostic_posture')?.categorical_exclusion_values?.join(',')
+        === 'blocked_quarantined,blocked_research_only'
+        ? 'pass'
+        : 'fail',
+    },
+    {
+      id: 'rights_display_is_not_visual_qa',
+      status: contract.posture_axes.find((axis) => axis.field === 'rights_display_status')?.not_visual_qa === true
+        ? 'pass'
+        : 'fail',
+    },
+    {
+      id: 'validator_fixtures_match_expected_fail_closed_behavior',
+      status: fixtureResults.every((fixture) => fixture.observed_valid === fixture.expected_valid) ? 'pass' : 'fail',
+    },
+    {
+      id: 'input_artifacts_loaded_without_diagnostics',
+      status: diagnostics.length === 0 ? 'pass' : 'fail',
+    },
+  ];
+
+  return checks.map((check) => ({ ...check, severity: check.status === 'pass' ? 'info' : 'critical' }));
+}
+
+function sourceArtifacts(root, paths, inputs) {
+  return [
+    sourceArtifact(root, 'figureasset_runtime_readiness_gate', paths.figureAssetRuntimeReadinessGate, inputs.runtimeGate),
+    sourceArtifact(root, 'full_beta_display_diagnostic_posture_map', paths.fullBetaDisplayDiagnosticPostureMap, inputs.displayPostureMap),
+    sourceArtifact(root, 'full_beta_runtime_source_map', paths.fullBetaRuntimeSourceMap, inputs.sourceMap),
+    sourceArtifact(root, 'full_beta_visual_required_inventory', paths.fullBetaVisualRequiredInventory, inputs.visualInventory),
+    sourceArtifact(root, 'kg_source_artifact_ingestion_manifest', paths.kgSourceArtifactIngestionManifest, inputs.sourceManifest),
+    sourceArtifact(root, 'method_map_evidence_availability_overlay', paths.methodMapEvidenceAvailabilityOverlay, inputs.methodOverlay),
+    sourceArtifact(root, 'procedure_blocker_resolution_final_gate', paths.procedureBlockerResolutionFinalGate, inputs.procedureGate),
+    sourceArtifact(root, 'question_render_source_document_registry', paths.questionRenderSourceDocumentRegistry, inputs.sourceDocumentRegistry),
+    sourceArtifact(root, 'source_figure_asset_production_index_full_858', paths.sourceFigureAssetProductionIndexFull858, inputs.figureAssetIndex),
+    sourceArtifact(root, 'source_figure_asset_rights_display_policy', paths.sourceFigureAssetRightsDisplayPolicy, inputs.rightsPolicy),
+    sourceArtifact(root, 'source_visual_receipts_production_full_858', paths.sourceVisualReceiptsProductionFull858, inputs.visualReceipts),
+  ].sort((left, right) => compareByteOrder(left.role, right.role));
+}
+
+function buildReadback(contract, validatorResult) {
+  const nodeRows = contract.node_families
+    .map((node) => `| ${node.node_family} | \`${node.stable_id_rule}\` | ${node.required_source} |`)
+    .join('\n');
+  const edgeRows = contract.edge_families
+    .map((edge) => `| \`${edge.edge_family}\` | ${edge.from_node} | ${edge.to_node} | ${edge.cardinality} |`)
+    .join('\n');
+  const postureRows = contract.posture_axes
+    .map((axis) => `| \`${axis.field}\` | ${axis.owner_node_family} | ${axis.independent_axis ? 'yes' : 'no'} | ${axis.fail_closed_semantics} |`)
+    .join('\n');
+  const invariantRows = contract.count_conservation_invariants
+    .map((invariant) => `| \`${invariant.invariant_id}\` | ${invariant.source_count} | ${invariant.expected_count} | \`${invariant.expression}\` |`)
+    .join('\n');
+  const fixtureRows = validatorResult.fixture_results
+    .map((fixture) => `| \`${fixture.fixture_id}\` | ${fixture.expected_valid} | ${fixture.observed_valid} | ${fixture.failure_codes.join(', ') || 'none'} |`)
+    .join('\n');
+
+  return `# KG V1 Node Edge Posture Contract Readback
+
+Generated: 2026-07-05
+
+Issue: #1281
+Parent: #1278
+Validator status: ${validatorResult.summary.validation_status}
+
+## Scope Counts
+
+| Metric | Count |
+| --- | ---: |
+| Real 9709 question rows | ${contract.scope.real_9709_question_rows} |
+| Normalized plain-text rows | ${contract.scope.normalized_plain_text_rows} |
+| Text-only ready rows | ${contract.scope.text_only_ready_rows} |
+| Visual-required rows | ${contract.scope.visual_required_rows} |
+| SourceFigureAsset rows | ${contract.scope.source_figure_asset_rows} |
+| SourceVisualReceipt accepted rows | ${contract.scope.source_visual_receipt_accepted_rows} |
+| Visual terminal blocker rows | ${contract.scope.visual_terminal_blocker_rows} |
+| Student-display eligible visual rows | ${contract.scope.student_display_eligible_visual_rows} |
+
+## Node Families
+
+| Node family | Stable ID rule | Required source |
+| --- | --- | --- |
+${nodeRows}
+
+## Edge Families
+
+| Edge family | From | To | Cardinality |
+| --- | --- | --- | --- |
+${edgeRows}
+
+## Independent Posture Axes
+
+| Field | Owner | Independent | Fail-closed rule |
+| --- | --- | --- | --- |
+${postureRows}
+
+Method diagnostic posture maps to EvidenceAvailabilityStatus as follows: \`available_verified\` -> \`strong_guidance_allowed\`; \`degraded\` and \`provisional\` -> \`candidate_guidance_only\`; \`unavailable\` -> \`routing_logging_review_queue_only\` or \`method_diagnosis_suppressed\`; \`blocked_quarantined\` and \`blocked_research_only\` -> \`method_diagnosis_suppressed\`.
+
+Rights/display is independent from visual QA. SourceVisualReceipt replay proves deterministic lineage only and does not grant rights/display.
+
+## Count Conservation Invariants
+
+| Invariant | Observed | Expected | Expression |
+| --- | ---: | ---: | --- |
+${invariantRows}
+
+## Fixture Validation
+
+| Fixture | Expected valid | Observed valid | Failure codes |
+| --- | --- | --- | --- |
+${fixtureRows}
+
+## Non-Goals Preserved
+
+- No import implementation.
+- No production DB schema or migration.
+- No frontend/UI wording change.
+- No remote Supabase mutation.
+`;
+}
+
+export function buildKgV1NodeEdgePostureContract(options = {}) {
+  const root = options.root ?? repoRootFromScript();
+  const paths = { ...DEFAULT_PATHS, ...(options.paths ?? {}) };
+  const generatedAt = options.generatedAt ?? DEFAULT_GENERATED_AT;
+  const { inputs, diagnostics } = loadInputs(root, paths);
+  const scope = buildScope(inputs);
+  const fixtures = validatorFixtures();
+  const fixtureResults = [...fixtures.good, ...fixtures.bad].map(validatePostureFixture);
+
+  const contract = {
+    schema_version: 'kg_v1_node_edge_posture_contract.v1',
+    generated_at: generatedAt,
+    issue: '#1281',
+    parent_issue: '#1278',
+    producer_script: SCRIPT_NAME,
+    scope,
+    source_artifacts: sourceArtifacts(root, paths, inputs),
+    node_families: nodeFamilies(),
+    edge_families: edgeFamilies(),
+    posture_axes: postureAxes(),
+    evidence_availability_status_vocabulary: EVIDENCE_AVAILABILITY_STATUSES,
+    method_diagnostic_posture_vocabulary: METHOD_DIAGNOSTIC_POSTURES,
+    rights_display_status_vocabulary: RIGHTS_DISPLAY_STATUSES,
+    review_routing_posture_vocabulary: REVIEW_ROUTING_POSTURES,
+    stable_id_rules: stableIdRules(),
+    count_conservation_invariants: countConservationInvariants(scope),
+    validator_fixtures: fixtures,
+    fail_closed_semantics: {
+      blocked_quarantined_style_states:
+        'blocked_quarantined and blocked_research_only are categorical exclusions and always suppress Method diagnostics.',
+      method_confidence:
+        'Method confidence controls diagnostic strength and review routing only; it is never a Question availability gate.',
+      rights_display:
+        'Rights/display is not visual QA and must be satisfied separately before any student-display eligibility claim.',
+      visual_receipt:
+        'SourceVisualReceipt replay is lineage evidence, not rights/display approval.',
+    },
+    non_goals: [
+      'no_import_implementation',
+      'no_production_db_schema',
+      'no_frontend_ui_wording_change',
+      'no_remote_supabase_mutation',
+    ],
+  };
+
+  const checks = buildChecks(contract, diagnostics, fixtureResults);
